mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (above 5.0%) compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, prompting central bank intervention and fiscal stimulus that boost equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) indicates sustainable consumer demand without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's aggressive tightening policy reduces corporate earnings growth potential, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1500.0 thousand units indicates robust residential construction activity, driving consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a self-reinforcing cycle of job creation and consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary demand regime (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 0.5%), government stimulus and central bank easing policies support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 0.5%.
